description: Edit fields (title, description, price, currency, location, details) on one of the USER'S OWN listings, identified by listing_id. Only the owner can edit; vertical/intent_type/role are fixed (publish a new listing to change those). Editing is free (no credit charge). Changing the title, description, location or details re-triggers AI moderation: the listing returns to 'pending' and is offline until cleared. Price/currency-only edits stay live. On a listing published by an assistant, price, currency and the money details are locked and rejected with price_locked.

currency.description: New ISO-4217 currency code. Rejected with price_locked on a listing published by an assistant. Example: "EUR".

description.description: New full listing text, up to 5000 characters. Returns the listing to "pending". Example: "Bright flat on the third floor, five minutes from the metro."

details.description: Vertical-specific attributes to change. Only these exact keys for the listing's vertical are accepted; any other key is rejected with an error. career: organization_name, employment_type, salary_min, salary_max, years_experience. real_estate: property_room_count, m2_gross, m2_net, building_age, floor_number, heating_type, deposit, dues, is_furnished, is_student_friendly, is_credit_eligible, tapu_status. vehicle: brand, model, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_mileage_km, fuel_type, gear_type, color, damage_status, daily_price, deposit. service: service_category. employment_type is one of full_time, part_time, contract, freelance, internship. is_furnished, is_student_friendly and is_credit_eligible are booleans. Any details edit returns the listing to "pending", so it goes offline until AI moderation clears it. On a listing published by an assistant, salary_min, salary_max, deposit and daily_price are locked and rejected with price_locked. Example: { "m2_gross": 90 }.

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".

location.description: New listing coordinates { lat, lon }. Moving a listing re-triggers AI moderation — it returns to "pending" until cleared. Example: { "lat": 48.85, "lon": 2.35 }.

price.description: New asking price as a plain number. Rejected with price_locked on a listing published by an assistant. To change a salary range use details.salary_min and details.salary_max. Example: 950.

title.description: New headline, 3-200 characters. Returns the listing to "pending". Example: "Two-bedroom flat near the river".

name: update_listing
